pattern_explanation: Spanish speakers may see the Spanish word transliterated as actual and assume it means the English word actual, because the spellings are identical. In Spanish the word refers to what is happening now, while English actual means real or true.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish word transliterated as actual means current or present, not actual. English actual means real or true, so do not match the Spanish word with actual; the correct English match is current.
